coverage_note: Read the whole file. Much of the lesson is English talk (56:49 on). Latin-transliterated stretches: 03:14-04:23, 06:14-08:27, 10:11-11:57, 24:10-26:48. Engine splits suffixes (min hom, ahel hom, ma hom, من هم) - treated as spacing, not slips. Echo: 'Uh, maba nasito' (09:18) = unclear attempt at a future word after her prompt مـ-مس; 'Musta'bal.' = مستقبل (repeat of her word). Engine garble not scored: بأسب (~batdaya2), مواسف/ماسب (~m3asseb/mu3assib), حندارة, براتولي, ما أجنب, كان مني (~kaan mnee7, 09:54 and 15:24), إشتى. Not scored: 01:29-01:35 جاوبت عليهم (Amal remark), self-fixes (أسول->أسئلة, أكل->أكلة, 30:20 كان أسوأ), 46:39 حروب تانية (Amal said both OK), 21:52 date without day number (chat only), 30:13 أول الـ اجتماع.

rows.medi_said: الواجب عندو تلات سو-- أسول-- أو-- Hold on. أسئلة.
rows.amal_said: صح. فيو ثلاث أسئلة. / فيو، in it. / It doesn't have. There's in it.
rows.why: He used 'has' (عندو) for 'the homework has three questions'; Amal supplied فيو (in it) and said 'It doesn't have'; he took it ('Oh, فيو').

rows.medi_said: أنا بحكي-- / أنا حكيت
rows.why: Telling about yesterday he began with present أنا بحكي; her 'وأنا؟' prompted and he switched to past حكيت.
rows.english: I spoke a lot of Arabic (yesterday)

rows.medi_said: uh, أمها أو أبوها. ... أمها أو أبوها, right? Aunts and uncles.
rows.amal_said: أوه، عمها وعمتها. Cuz ولاد أمها are أخوتها.
rows.why: He wanted her cousins (kids of aunts and uncles) and said mother's or father's kids; Amal gave عمها وعمتها and explained ولاد أمها = her siblings.
rows.english: her cousins (children of her aunts and uncles)

rows.medi_said: bifikru el lugha muhim ilhom
rows.why: لغة is feminine, so the adjective needs the feminine form; he said 'Oh, it's feminine' and changed to muhema.
rows.english: I think the language is important to them

rows.medi_said: Uh, rah fikun.
rows.amal_said: راح. / Yeah، بس لغة as well.
rows.why: The ykoon form must match the feminine subject لغة (tkoon); Amal's hint 'لغة as well' led him to the feminine.
rows.english: It is going to be important

rows.medi_said: il modara. No, modara is present. ... moraja. / Fi il modara. Fi il musta-musta'bal.
rows.amal_said: Do you remember the word for future؟ / مراجعة. / مـ-مس... / مستقبل.
rows.why: Asked for the word for 'future' he gave مضارع (present-tense term) and مراجعة (review); Amal walked him to مستقبل (sheet: future | Musta2bal). He repeated the wrong 'fi il modara' at 09:35 before fixing it (same moment).

rows.medi_said: Do I know how to say adults? I don't know how to say adults.
rows.amal_said: Just we say the big ones يعني the big. / الكبار.
rows.why: Didn't-know: he asked how to say adults; Amal gave 'the big ones' and then الكبار.

rows.medi_said: libisna costume bas kul il zgar
rows.chat: fi el-3azoome shwai min el-kbaar ma lebsu lebset Haloween bas kul el-z8aar lebsu
rows.why: He described the adults ('they'), not himself, so the verb must be 3rd-person plural; he agreed ('Okay. It would be لبسوا?').
rows.english: Some of the adults did not dress up, but all the kids did

rows.medi_said: costume bas...
rows.amal_said: How about you say a Halloween outfit. We don't really have a costume.
rows.why: English 'costume' dropped in; Amal said Arabic has no costume word and gave 'Halloween outfit', he built libsa Halloween (costume is not on her sheet).

rows.medi_said: Uh, libsa Halloween. Libsa, right?
rows.why: A feminine first word grows -t in idafa; Amal said لبست and he repeated 'Libsit Halloween'.

rows.medi_said: كان حلووات كتير. كانوا حلوات كتير. ... كل، كل ولاد.
rows.amal_said: لأ، عاد صغار بس حلوين قول حلوات.
rows.why: He used the feminine plural for the kids (mixed/boys); Amal told him to say حلوين (chat 7elween); he echoed 'حلوين'. Engine wrote her line oddly.

rows.medi_said: كل حدا، جابوا واحد أكلة.
rows.amal_said: إيه wait... كل حدا أو كل شخص. صح. بس now I'm describing one. So jab أو jabu. Cos I'm saying person.
rows.why: كل حدا (every person) is singular, so the verb is جاب not جابوا; he said 'Oh, you're right. جاب'.

rows.medi_said: واحد أكل، أكلة. No، واحدة أكلة.
rows.amal_said: آ، واحدة is an adjective. So what do where do I put it؟ ... مهم. صح.
rows.why: The adjective واحدة goes after the noun; Amal prompted 'where do I put it' and he gave أكلة واحدة.

rows.medi_said: كل عيلتها، طلبوني.
rows.chat: kul 3aieltha talabu minni enno ajeeb kabaab
rows.why: طلب takes min for asking someone (sheet: ba6lob min); طلبوني means 'they ordered me'. He kept trying (طلبوا عليّ، لي) until طلبوا مني.
rows.english: Her whole family asked me to bring kebab

rows.medi_said: طلبوا مني، إنه جبت kebab. ... إنه supreme؟ ولا just جيب؟ فجيب؟
rows.why: After 'asked me that' the second verb is a bare present (أجيب), not past جبت; Amal gave 'to bring' then أجيب.

rows.medi_said: Oh God, what was spinach? I forgot the word. ... شو الكلمة spinach؟
rows.amal_said: جبنة with spinach ما باب؟ ... سبانخ.
rows.why: Didn't-know: he asked for the word and Amal gave سبانخ (sheet: spinach | sabane5).

rows.medi_said: أوو، آخر واحد، last one. آخر واحدة، واحد، آخر واحد.
rows.amal_said: I said kind. ... What's kind? / One kind.
rows.why: For 'the last kind' he said آخر واحد (one); Amal said 'I said kind' and he got آخر نوع.

rows.medi_said: بيضة. / مثل بيضة like eggs and cheese, right؟
rows.amal_said: إنت بتعرف الجبنة البيضا؟ ... لا، لا... It's a type of cheese. جبنة بيضا.
rows.why: Asked if he knows white cheese (الجبنة البيضا) he repeated it as بيضة (an egg); Amal said no, it is a cheese type, جبنة بيضا.

rows.medi_said: يوم الثلاث،
rows.why: Asked what day it is he said Tuesday; Amal said 'No' and he corrected to يوم الاثنين.

rows.medi_said: أنا بأسب منهم. / أنا بأسب لهم
rows.amal_said: Mm-mm. I got upset for them. / Mm-mm.
rows.why: Feeling bad for someone takes 3ala (sheet: batDaaya2 3ala), not min or li; he tried min, li, then asked 'is it ala?' and Amal said Saħħ (alayhom).

rows.medi_said: أنا بأسب منهم. ... أنا بدي، آه...
rows.why: The sentence is past ('I got upset'); he used a present b- form and Amal's 'I got.' pushed him to the past (داية it / tdaaya2et).

rows.medi_said: akher. No, tahet. / Under. Uh, tahet.
rows.amal_said: Mm-hmm. La saħħ. Shu yammi taħet. It's not taħet.
rows.why: For 'the end of the movie' he said tahet (under); Amal said 'It's not taħet'; he returned to akher il film (sheet: aa5er = last / end).

rows.medi_said: أنا جاوبت على أغلب من-- أغلب الـ، أغلب السؤال, or ... أسئلة
rows.why: a8lab is followed by a definite noun (el-), not من; Amal's 'Il.' prompt; Medi himself later says 'I said أغلب من and you corrected me'. His أغلب الـ came at about the same moment as her prompt.
rows.english: I answered most of the questions

rows.medi_said: من الـ آخر than the end, right? ... من الـ آخر. ... آخر هي هو؟ Is it آخره؟
rows.amal_said: The end of it. / Just it. / صح، آخره.
rows.chat: awal el-ijtemaa3 kaan aswa2 min aa5ro
rows.why: 'The end of it' needs the owner ending on aa5er (آخره) with no el-; Amal hinted 'the end of it' and 'Just it', then confirmed آخره.

rows.medi_said: منيح بس ما حبيت الـ آخرو.
rows.chat: awal el-felem mnaa7 bas mnee7 bas maa 7abbait aa5ro
rows.why: A word with an ending pronoun is already definite, so no el-; Amal 'No ال. Why?' and he answered 'because it's conjugated' (right after learning it at 31:14).
rows.english: I didn't like the end of it

rows.medi_said: غير تاني. No، إشي غير من هم.
rows.why: 8eir comes before the noun; Amal recast غير إشي and he said 'غير always comes before the noun'.

rows.medi_said: uh, كان angering ... (about أخبار)
rows.amal_said: بيعصب بس كان أو كانوا cuz أخبار is multiple news / plural.
rows.why: أخبار is plural so the verb is كانوا not كان; Amal explained, then he restarted with كانو (42:33).
rows.english: the news was/were making me angry

rows.medi_said: أنا قرأت الأخبار، أوّل الصباح، أو بيعصبوا.
rows.chat: ana qara2et el-a5baar awal el-subu7 u kaanu bey3assbu
rows.why: Past continuous needs kaan before the present verb; Amal said 'they were' and he added كانو.

rows.medi_said: أنا قرأت الأخبار ... (قرأت-- What did I say? ... I think I said قريت)
rows.why: Engine wrote قرأت; he thinks he said colloquial قريت; Amal repeated قرأت twice (sheet: Ana qara2et). Her 'It's not [internal slipping]' makes the intent unclear, so low confidence.

rows.medi_said: أوّل مرة بالصباح، أو-- / بالصباح؟
rows.why: He said 'first time in the morning'; Amal's 'في ... in the morning' prompt and her chat awal el-subu7 show the intended 'first thing in the morning' (awal + el-); he restarted with أوّل الصباح. Prompt is vague.

rows.medi_said: الحرب راح، راح يسير أسوأ. ... راح تصير أسوأ.
rows.amal_said: أممم، آه، sharp is (engine; likely 'حرب is feminine') / صح.
rows.chat: ana bazonn enno el-7arb ra7 tseer aswa2
rows.why: حرب (war) is a hidden-gender feminine noun, so the verb is تصير; he switched after Amal's hint and she said صح.
rows.english: The war is going to get worse

rows.medi_said: لما أنا أطلع الطبيعة
rows.why: 'Look at' is أتطلع على, not أطلع (go out); Amal's 'أطلع at.' reminded him and he said أتطلع (chat at6alla3 3ala).

rows.medi_said: لما أنا أطلع الطبيعة
rows.why: The verb needs its preposition على; his first try had none; Amal's 'at.' prompted it.

rows.medi_said: إشي المفضل عندي. Or المفضل إشي عندي.
rows.amal_said: Where do you put the Ls? ... Where is the other L? You have another L. Where do you put it?
rows.chat: el-ishi el-mufaddal 3indi lamma ana at6alla3 3ala el-6abi3a
rows.why: Both the noun and the adjective take el- in noun + mufaddal; Amal asked where the other L goes (engine may have dropped his el- on إشي), then said صح.

rows.medi_said: No, your صحابك تانيين.
rows.why: A noun with a pronoun ending is definite so the adjective takes el- (Amal explained 'Because صحابك is definitive').

rows.medi_said: عائلتي, my other family, it would be التاني.
rows.why: عائلة is feminine so the adjective is التانية.

rows.medi_said: هذي أول مرة أول يومي هون.
rows.why: يوم is masculine so 'this' is هذا not هذي.
rows.english: This is my first day here

rows.medi_said: هذي أول مرة أول يومي هون. / هذي أول اليومي هون.
rows.amal_said: أول يومي is what? ... No. What does أول يومي mean? ... No.
rows.why: أول + a noun with a possessive ending means 'the beginning of my day'; for 'my first day' use يومي الأول or هذا أول يوم إلي; Amal said 'No' repeatedly and gave hints.

rows.medi_said: يوم الأول.
rows.why: Treating أول as an adjective, the noun must carry the owner ending (يومي); Amal's 'يوم هو' prompted it and she said صح.

rows.medi_said: Shwe min kbar, libisna costume
rows.chat: fi el-3azoome shwai min el-kbaar ma lebsu
rows.why: He said 'some of adults' without el-; her typed line has el-kbaar; she never voiced it.

rows.medi_said: Their ahel hom, yehku inglisi ma hom.
rows.chat: humme yefhammu kter bas lamma laazem ye7ku... ahelhom bye7ku inglizi ma3hom.
rows.why: A habit ('their parents speak English') needs b- (chat bye7ku); he dropped it; she let it pass.
rows.english: their parents speak English with them
